groups.name: Skip threshold reduced to one file
groups.rationale: Changes the grouping logic to send every diff of two files or more to the model instead of using a configurable threshold, making git's alphabetical order never the final output for multi-file diffs.
groups.watch: The skip condition now hardcodes `files.length <= 1` instead of checking the config threshold; this change is irreversible without backward-incompatible config removal, and the reason message claims every one-file diff has nothing to order, which must hold true.

groups.name: Config migration for retired threshold
groups.rationale: Removes `groupingThreshold` from the active config interface and marks it as retired so old configs load without error but the value is never used.
groups.watch: The retired key is still accepted in KNOWN_KEYS to prevent upgrade failures, but it is not read into the returned config object; a config file with only `groupingThreshold` set and no other required keys will still fail validation on missing `model` or `thinking`, which is correct.

groups.name: Documentation and help text
groups.rationale: Updates spec, skill description, and test output to reflect the new behavior: only one-file diffs skip grouping, and `groupingThreshold` no longer controls anything.
groups.watch: The spec claims every diff of two files or more goes to the model, and the reason message now says '1 changed file: nothing to order' instead of the threshold comparison; these claims must match the code's actual behavior.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
